key_insight: A privacy-preserving local pipeline combining a small language model and regular expressions can accurately extract uncoded urinary tract infection features from multilingual primary care EHR narratives.
clinical_relevance: This approach helps turn free-text notes into structured variables for clinical research and quality improvement without sending sensitive patient data to external cloud services.
method: Deployed the open-weight Phi4-mini model on institutional hardware with Ollama.
Refined prompts with clinicians and added deterministic regular expressions after model inference.
Validated performance against a clinician-reviewed gold standard and a noisy synthetic test set.
evidence_signal: In 15,498 MEAP narratives from 2,962 patients, the system extracted 4,663 feature occurrences and achieved 93.8% accuracy with strong specificity in real-world validation.
watch_item: Performance was tested on a relatively small clinician-reviewed sample and may vary when adapted to other settings, languages, or note styles.
paper_title: Uncoded Clinical Features from Multilingual Electronic Health Records in Catalonia: Development and Validation Study
